name: knowledge-wiki
title_zh: 把散落文章整理成可检索的个人知识库
tagline_zh: 你分享的文章、聊出的洞见，随手一丢就再也找不到？它替你归档、链接、沉淀，下次问一句就能捞回来。
tagline_en: Articles you share and insights you chat about get lost? It files, links, and surfaces them—ask once, retrieve.
desc_en: Manage the personal knowledge wiki. Use when the user shares articles, documents, or asks to organize knowledge; when a conversation produces insights worth preserving as structured knowledge; or when the user asks about the knowledge base.
why_zh: 不是简单存文件，而是按语义拆解、建立关联，让知识库随对话自然生长，问它就能定位到原始出处。
why_en: Not just file storage—it parses semantically, links concepts, and grows with your chats, tracing every answer back to source.
limit_zh: 只处理文本类内容（文章/对话/文档），不解析PDF图表、音视频；需要你主动触发保存，不会自动抓取网页。
limit_en: Text-only (articles/chats/docs); no PDF charts, audio, or video. Requires manual save trigger—no auto web scraping. Retrieval only covers.
